title: Identity Curvature Laplace Approximation for Improved Out-of-Distribution Detection (ICLA)
venue_status: WACV 2025 open access - VERIFIED in proceedings listing
evidence_depth: Abstract, method sentence, Table 1 AUROCs and training schedule read from arXiv v2 HTML; re-verified by citation agent
decision_reason: Textbook Bayes chain (prior, likelihood, Gaussian posterior via identity curvature, prior precision chosen by marginal likelihood) with the Hessian deliberately removed, so fitting is one cheap post-hoc pass on a normally trained net. VERIFIED: ResNet-18 + SGD, 100 epochs on CIFAR-10/100, 90 on ImageNet-200; CIFAR-10 far-OOD AUROC 92.50+/-0.38 vs 91.54+/-0.36 for LLLA(GGN). Caveat: headline metric is OOD AUROC, not K-way accuracy; 'trained from scratch' is inferred from the setup wording, not verbatim

title: Unveiling Empirical Pathologies of Laplace Approximation for Uncertainty Estimation
venue_status: SAME arXiv record as B-P02: 2312.10464 v1 carries this title, v2 carries the WACV 2025 ICLA title
decision_reason: BIBLIOGRAPHIC WARNING: do not count B-P02 and B-P07 as two independent studies and pin the version in every citation. Substantive content: Hessian fitting creates a gradient bottleneck, fails to widen the uncertainty surface for outliers, and 'calibration scores remain similar across methods', so the authors recommend discarding full Hessian computation for OOD. This is what motivates B-P02 and gives the report a defensible design rationale
